description: This file is a PHP script that generates a web page for adding a new port triggering rule in a network gateway configuration interface. It includes HTML markup, JavaScript validation, and server-side PHP includes, representing a form with associated client-side validation and AJAX submission logic.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the page by setting the title and navigation highlight, and binding validation rules.

methods.name: addMethod port
methods.description: Custom validation rule to verify port number is within valid range 0-65535.

methods.name: addMethod triggermore
methods.description: Custom validation rule to ensure trigger port 'from' is less than or equal to 'to' port.

methods.name: addMethod targetmore
methods.description: Custom validation rule to ensure target port 'from' is less than or equal to 'to' port.
